movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Holding hands in pairs or groups, performing movements over paddy
movement_profile.partnering: Men and women dance together holding hands without blood relation

signature_moves.description: Dancers hold hands and move rhythmically over the paddy to symbolically separate husks
signature_moves.name: Hand-holding over paddy

music_profile.musical_form: Call and response style in Palam folk song
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Derived from rhythmic chanting 'Ha... Ha... Ha...' in Palam song
music_profile.sound_description: The music features rhythmic vocal chanting evolved from villagers shouting to scare birds, forming the Palam folk song that guides the dance.
music_profile.vocal_style: Folk singing with rhythmic calls to scare birds

basic_steps: Hold hands with partners or group members
Form a straight line or circle
Step rhythmically in time with Palam song
Repeat call 'Ha... Ha... Ha...' to mimic scaring birds
teaching.formation: Pairs or groups in straight line or circular formation
teaching.level_notes: Historically performed for seven days and nights; beginners start with holding hands and stepping in time
teaching.rhythm: Rhythmic pattern matching the Palam folk song
